eligibility_evidence: This role is responsible for the design, deployment, management, and support of critical infrastructure systems—including servers, virtualization platforms, networking, storage, and compute resources hosted within on-site data centres as well as design and deploying to cloud hosted environments.

Responsibilities On premises server environment & Infrastructure Management Maintain, monitor, and optimise Subco's on-premises server environments (compute, storage, networking) supporting critical systems that underpin international submarine cable operations.

Security & Compliance Uphold security standards, access controls, and compliance frameworks across hybrid infrastructure, supporting audits, disaster recovery testing, and cyber-resilience initiatives in close partnership with security teams.
Are skilled in designing, deploying, and managing AWS cloud infrastructure, hybrid environments, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Reliability & Operations Support Monitor system health, alerting, and observability across on-prem and cloud environments to ensure high availability, with hands-on incident troubleshooting in collaboration with the NOC and network engineering teams — including on-call rotation.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer | Enterprise Networking & Security
review_candidates.description_excerpt: 🔹 Administración avanzada de protocolos BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, MPLS, tecnologías Layer 2/Layer 3 . 🔹 Administración e ingeniería de plataformas de seguridad perimetral basadas en Palo Alto, Fortinet y Cisco . ✔️ Experiencia real administrando infraestructuras productivas de routing y switching.
